messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: High 95p latency & error spike on embeddings endpoint /v1/embeddings (us-east-1). Detected at 2025-06-15T10:16:40Z. Auto-rate-limit kicking in. Paging eng-oncall.

maria: seeing it on the dashboard. embeddings qps up ~6x from baseline, error rate 8% 5m.

alex: confirmed. Many requests from a small set of API keys (top 3 keys = 72% of traffic). Looks like a customer-side batch job. Starting investigation.

sachin: can we do a soft-per-route throttle before doing global measures? prefer to avoid disabling features.

maria: yes. Plan: 1) carve per-endpoint quota for /v1/embeddings route (reduce to 50% for top offending keys) 2) apply weighted prioritization to chat routes so user-facing requests keep precedence 3) hold rerank route autoscaling for now. I'll run the carve.

alex: tagging @ops-rot for quota change approval.

ops-rot: approved. Execute the following playbook snippet:
```
POST /admin/quotas/carve
{
  "route": "/v1/embeddings",
  "targets": ["key-abc123","key-def456"],
  "qps_multiplier": 0.5,
  "duration": "30m",
  "reason": "live-mitigation - noisy embed job"
}
```

maria: applied carve to key-abc123 and key-def456 -> effective now. Also added route-level soft-throttle: 60 rps burst, 30 sustained.

sachin: observability notes: KV cache hit rate decreased slightly after throttle, but tail latency for chat remains within SLO. Embeds error rate dropped to 2% in last 2 minutes.

jen: are we blocking any customers? need to notify support if any paid customers impacted.

alex: not blocking yet — soft throttle only. But top offending key got its QPS halved which will slow bulk jobs. I'll DM the account team to preemptively notify.

maria: also toggled rerank path to read-only -> disabled model fallback for rerank to prevent extra autoscale thrash. Command used:
```
PATCH /admin/routes/rerank
{"state":"paused","reason":"reduce noise during embed spike"}
```

sachin: setting up a short-term traffic split: prefer chat traffic to dedicated pool A, embeds to pool B with strict QPS caps. Routing rule added.

ops-rot: monitoring infra: spinning up one extra ded pool for embeds not allowed due to capacity; route caps are best-effort.

incident-bot: Incident annotated: mitigation_type=per-route-quota-carve, affected_routes=["/v1/embeddings","/v1/rerank"], severity=sev3.

maria: next steps: keep carve for 30m, if embeds QPS stays high we'll escalate to full key suspension; if it stabilizes we will gradually lift carve. I'll update in 10m.

alex: FYI put this on-call handoff note for morning shift: embed-heavy client; consider longer-term per-customer quotas and burst-detection alerts.

jen: I'll ping support and CSMs with a short note: "We've applied temporary rate limits to a customer's bulk embedding job to protect service quality; investigating and will follow up." :email:

sachin: metrics now: 95p latency for embeddings down from 4.2s -> 1.1s, error rate down to 1.6%. Chat p95 unchanged at ~120ms.

maria: closing mitigation loop: removing immediate customer-facing disruption. Leaving carve active until 1777777300 (30m) then reassess. Handing off to morning oncall.

ops-rot: handoff ack. recorded runbook steps and commands used. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Handoff: oncall_next=morn_oncall, handoff_ts=1777777300."
